verdict.rationale: Langfuse's self-host pricing page states the core is MIT-licensed, the self-hosting docs call it open source, and llms.txt links to the public GitHub repo. Community users report running 'Langfuse OSS' and working directly with the self-hosted code. Missing for 10: clarity on how the license-key-gated enterprise features (RBAC, audit logs, data retention) are licensed versus the MIT core.
